rationale: At the 0.45 floor runs are reg-to-reg limited at ss 100C max-RC; hold is positive without buffers, DRC and slew/cap are 0, so only path quality matters. Raising margins 0.2/0.25 to 0.4/0.4 gave an identical result: repair is stuck, not margin-bound, so the starting placement must improve. Two loose runs with the same AREA 3 + ABC buffering/sizing synthesis but non-timing-driven, routability-driven placement at 52-55% density reached ~6.97 ns reg-to-reg unrepaired, versus 8.81 ns for the timing-driven md5 recipe at 9.37 ns. Setting 1 adopts that placement (TDP off, routability on, 52%); setting 2 keeps timing-driven placement at 41% and adds routability, isolating the factor. Both keep cap213, post-GRT repairs, 0.4 margins.
